sentences.en: The editor and the publisher were present at the party.
sentences.zh: 编辑和出版商出席了那次聚会。

sentences.en: The publisher said I have to trim down my book.
sentences.zh: 出版商说我必须缩减我的书的篇幅。

sentences.en: The journalists who write for this publisher are not impartial.
sentences.zh: 为这家出版社撰稿的记者并不公正。

senses.zh: 出版者，出版商，出版社,公布者，发表者,〈美〉办报者
